annotations.title: Get Share of Voice across a saved keyword list

description: Share of Voice across a saved keyword list: the project's own domain plus up to 3 competitor domains, scored over a saved-keyword tag ("a saved keyword list" in this codebase IS a saved-keyword tag — omit tagId/tagName to mean every saved keyword in the project). Reuses the EXACT Share of Voice computation rank tracking's own Share of Voice already uses (CTR-weighted visibility, a comparative index — never a click forecast). BILLABLE-ADJACENT: one live SERP fetch per keyword in the resolved list, up to a bounded per-run cap (see `truncated`) — a saved list carries no stored positions the way a rank-tracking config does. The project's own domain is read from the project row, never accepted as a parameter. `keywordsFailed` keywords (a SERP fetch that errored) are excluded from the computation, never counted as "ranks nowhere".

competitorDomains.description: 0-3 competitor domains (bare domain or full URL).

languageCode.description: Language code (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr'). Omit it to use the project's default market language, which falls back to 'en'.

locationCode.description: DataForSEO location code. Omit it to use the project's default market, which falls back to 2840 (United States) for a project that has not set one. See dataforseo.com/help-center/locations. Some countries (e.g. Iceland, 2352) are served from Google Ads data: keyword volume/CPC/trends work, but keyword difficulty, search intent, and domain analytics are unavailable.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

tagId.description: The saved-keyword tag ID to treat as 'the list'. Omit with tagName to mean every saved keyword in the project.

tagName.description: Alternative to tagId — the tag's name.

name: get_keyword_list_share_of_voice
